## Tata Product and Feature Updates

For enterprise buyers, Tata's relevant offerings typically include TCS digital transformation services, Tata Communications network/cloud connectivity, and entity-specific managed services.

## New Product Launches
- AI-enabled transformation services across TCS cloud and data practices
- Enhanced network and cloud connectivity offerings through Tata Communications
- Industry modernization packages for banking, retail, manufacturing, and telecom

## Major Feature Updates
- Expanded automation in IT operations and application support
- Increased focus on cloud-native modernization and data platforms
- Stronger sustainability and governance messaging across group companies

## Platform Enhancements
Tata entities continue to invest in digital delivery models, cloud partnerships, automation accelerators, and industry-specific solutions.

## Product Deprecations
- Legacy delivery models may be replaced by managed, cloud-native, or outcome-oriented contracts

## Regulatory Updates
Contracts should account for data residency, cross-border delivery, cybersecurity, and industry compliance.
